### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

- Target object: "the home visit on Sunday the 20th, early in the morning", at which "your husband Martin and your daughter Claire were drawn at the same visit"; action: "pay for that home visit today, on your card"; "You want it settled now, not a quote for later".
- Authorisation: "you are happy for the representative to do whatever needs doing on their side to get it ready for you to pay"; "If the representative explains that the charges for the visit have to be put through on their end first ... you say that's fine and to go ahead."
- Payment is a user-executed tool: "When the representative tells you the amount to pay and hands the payment over to you, you pay it yourself, for exactly the amount they gave you, against the visit and the charge reference they read out, using your Visa credit card."
- The simulator only conveys the need, supplies details on request (phone 3125550188, DOB 1968-02-11, ZIP, how/when booked, Blue Cross ended in March) and responds conditionally; it does not volunteer amounts ("You don't know any of the amounts"). Clear.

### 4. Scored parameters — formula, inputs, tiers, values

**Trip charge** (computation doc "Mobile In-Home Collection Visit Trip Charge — Zone Fees and Calculation": "the band fee of the trip is taken first; any amount added to the trip is added to the band fee; that sum is multiplied by the dispatch notice rate; any credit on the trip is subtracted from that product ... never below 0.00 ... rounded to the cent only once, at the end").
- Pricing band — "Weekend Hub Dispatch and Zone Pricing": "a visit whose appointment date is a Sunday is priced two zone bands farther out ... The band never goes beyond service zone 3." Booked zone_2, Sunday → zone 3. (records: `service_zone zone_2`, appointment 2026-09-20 Sunday)
- Band fee — "Standing-Order Series Routes": standing order with "Six or more" test charges in the last six months → "The fee of the band one nearer than the pricing band" → zone 2 → 95.00. (records: `standing_order True`, 9 `orders_test_charge_posted` lines)
- Additions — "Early-Route Premium": Sunday, start 07:00 "before 07:30 on a Saturday or Sunday" → 15.00; "Specimen Handling Kits": Specialty Clinical Testing → 12.00.
- Rate — "Dispatch Notice Rates": notice 2026-09-17 → 2026-09-20 = 3 days, "Three days or fewer | 1.15".
- Credit — "Redraw Credit ... After a Specimen Rejection": rejection `leaked_in_transit` on 2026-08-24 lies in the last three months → 25.00 (the 06-15 hemolyzed rejection lies outside the window; it would not change the tier anyway: "At least one | At least one | 25.00").
- Trip = (95.00 + 15.00 + 12.00) × 1.15 − 25.00 = 140.30 − 25.00 = **115.30**.

**Household charge** ("Household Charge Calculation": per-member rate formed first, × members counted, + any amount on the household as a whole; round once).
- Member rate — "Standing-Order Member Rates": standing order, six or more charges → 25.00.
- Per-member amounts — "Booking-Notice Adjustment to Household Member Rates": notice 3 → "Adds 5.00 to each member's rate"; "Member Specimen Kits": Specialty Clinical Testing → 2.00. Per-member rate 32.00.
- Members counted — "Shared Extended Dispatch": assessed trip fee 115.30 vs zone 2 published 95.00 (booked zone): above 95.00, below 118.75, two members → 1 + 0.75 = 1.75.
- Household-whole addition — "Early-Household Addition": Sunday, start before 07:30 → "10.00 for each additional household member drawn", "reckoned on the members actually drawn at the visit, each in full" → 20.00.
- Household = 32.00 × 1.75 + 20.00 = 56.00 + 20.00 = **76.00**.

**Weekend charge** ("Weekend Charge Calculation": weekend day rate + amounts added, then "multiplied in turn by each multiplier"; round once).
- Day rate — "Weekend Day Rates": Sunday → 50.00.
- Additions — "Weekend Call-In Staffing": notice 3 → "Adds 10.00"; "Weekend Courier to the Reference Laboratory": Specialty Clinical Testing → 15.00. Weekend amount 75.00.
- Multipliers — "Weekend Dispatch Overlap": assessed trip fee 115.30 vs listed 95.00 (zone 2) → above, below 118.75 → 0.75; "Per-Person Weekend Staffing": assessed additional-patient fee on the record and 2 members → (1 + 2) × 0.50 = 1.50; "Standing-Series Weekend Rotation": standing, six or more → 0.65.
- Weekend = 75.00 × 0.75 × 1.50 × 0.65 = 54.84375 → **54.84**.

**Home-visit settlement charge** ("Home-Visit Settlement Charge": open total of trip, additional-patient, weekend and late-change charges; percentage allowances added into one total and applied once; round once).
- Open total: 115.30 + 76.00 + 54.84 + late-change (68.00 assessed − 68.00 paid = 0.00) = 246.14.
- Allowances: "Multi-Charge Allowance" all three assessed → 3%; "Paying-History Allowance" 3 payments in last 12 months → 3%; "Prompt-Settlement Allowance": "Days to Settlement" — posting date = latest assessed date on the visit = 2026-10-04 (after the three postings), collection 2026-09-20, delay 14 > 7 → counted from the posting date to today = 0 days → "10 or fewer | No" → 5%; "Self-Pay Allowance": order `self_pay`, only coverage terminated → 10%. Total 21%.
- Settlement = 246.14 × (1 − 0.21) = 194.4506 → **194.45**.

**Fall-back answers (computation documents only, no factor):** trip = zone 2 published fee 95.00 × 1.00 = 95.00; household = 35.00 × 2 = 70.00; weekend = 35.00; settlement = 95.00 + 70.00 + 35.00 + 0.00 = 200.00. All definite and all different from the values above (115.30 / 76.00 / 54.84 / 194.45).

**Findability (record words → factor document):** Sunday appointment date / 07:00 start → Weekend Hub Dispatch, Early-Route Premium, Weekend Day Rates, Early-Household Addition (KB_search "Sunday home visit trip", "early start 07:00 Sunday household" rank them top-3); `standing_order True` + test-charge lines → Standing-Order Series Routes, Standing-Order Member Rates, Standing-Series Weekend Rotation ("standing order household member", "Sunday weekend charge standing order"); `booked_date`/`appointment_date` notice → Dispatch Notice Rates, Booking-Notice Adjustment, Weekend Call-In Staffing ("booked date appointment date notice home visit"); `Specialty Clinical Testing` → Handling Kits, Member Specimen Kits, Weekend Courier ("Specialty Clinical Testing home visit"); `leaked_in_transit` rejection → Redraw Credit (rank 1); `self_pay` + terminated coverage → Self-Pay Allowance (rank 1); invoice payments → Paying-History Allowance (rank 1); assessed trip-fee line amount → Shared Extended Dispatch, Weekend Dispatch Overlap; assessed additional-patient line → Per-Person Weekend Staffing. No computation document told me a variation exists or that certain customers qualify; each factor was reached from the records. Observation for the dependency-form scan (not a finding yet): the four posting/hub documents say the charge "is worked out by calculation rather than read straight off the published zone fee" / "rather than as a flat amount per member" / "rather than as one flat surcharge" / "rather than as one flat fee" — this phrasing tells a reader the posted figure differs from the flat published figure.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root problem: the customer's own write — the home-visit settlement payment (user tool).

- Hop R→Trip (**state-derived**). Settlement doc: "The home-visit settlement charge is taken only after the trip fee assessed on the visit stands on its fee record." `find_visit_events` shows no trip-fee line on `e59cf1b2`. Searching for the write that puts an "assessed trip fee" on the fee record → "Trip Charge on Collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visits — Posting Reference": "It is posted on the visit as one assessed trip fee ... from then the visit's fee history shows the assessed trip fee".
- Hop R→Household (**state-derived**). Settlement doc: "No home-visit settlement charge is taken until the visit carries the assessed additional-patient fee owed for the household members drawn at it." Record: `additional_household_patients: 2`, no additional-patient line. Write found in "Household Charge for Additional Members Drawn at a Home Visit": "posted on the visit as one assessed additional-patient fee".
- Hop R→Weekend (**state-derived**). Settlement doc: "For a visit dated on a Saturday or Sunday, the home-visit settlement charge is worked out only after its assessed weekend surcharge is on the fee record." Record: appointment 2026-09-20 = Sunday; no weekend line. Write found in "Weekend Charge on Saturday and Sunday Home Visits": "posted on the visit as one assessed weekend surcharge".
- Hop Household→Trip (**state-derived**). Household hub: "The household charge on a home visit is fixed only after the visit carries an assessed trip fee." (restated on the fee record in the same document).
- Hop Weekend→Trip (**state-derived**). Weekend hub: "The weekend charge on a Saturday or Sunday home visit is not worked out until the visit's fee record shows its assessed trip fee."
- Hop Weekend→Household (**state-derived**). Weekend hub: "Before the weekend charge is worked out for a visit that drew additional household members, the visit must carry its assessed additional-patient fee." Record: 2 members drawn.
- Problems: {Trip charge posting, Household charge posting, Weekend charge posting, Settlement payment}. Edges: Settlement → {Trip, Household, Weekend}; Household → Trip; Weekend → {Trip, Household}. Unique handling order: Trip → Household → Weekend → Settlement. The factor rules agree with the order (Shared Extended Dispatch and Weekend Dispatch Overlap read the assessed trip fee amount; Per-Person Weekend Staffing reads the assessed additional-patient fee; Days to Settlement reads the latest assessment date).
- No hop was pre-solved: no document named another problem's tool, a route or a chain; each blocked hub names only its own tool.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternative object: the late-change charge on the same visit — excluded from re-charging: already assessed and paid (68.00 / 68.00), stands open for 0.00 under "its assessed amount, less any waiver posted against it, less any payment posted against it".
- Alternative trip pricing on the booked band (zone 2 → series zone 1 = 75.00): excluded by Series Routes "applied to the trip's pricing band (the zone band at which the home trip is priced on its appointment date)" + Weekend Hub ("Sunday ... two zone bands farther out").
- Alternative reading that the redraw credit needs a recollection-purpose visit (this visit is `standing_order_draw`): excluded — the ladder conditions read only the order's rejections in the last three months ("Is the credit tied to the patient or to the order? To the order the visit collects"), and a recollection-purpose home visit carries no fee at all (Assessment A.5; Recollection provisions table "Yes"), so reading "redraw" as recollection purpose would leave the credit with no possible trip. Recorded as the one place where a reader must reason past wording ("When a home trip is a redraw for an order whose specimen the laboratory rejected").
- Alternative early-household figure 10.00 × 1.75: excluded by "reckoned on the members actually drawn at the visit, each in full".
- Alternative days-to-settlement count from the 2026-09-18 late-change line (→ 14 days → 2%): excluded — the settlement charge is worked out only after the three charges stand on the record, so the latest assessment date is today; "When the visit carries fee lines assessed on different dates, the latest of those dates is the posting date."
- Alternative sequential allowances (×0.97×0.97×0.95×0.90): excluded by "the allowances never act one after another".
- "Do only what the customer asked" (hand over the payment tool now): excluded — with no assessed trip fee on the record the settlement charge "is taken only after the trip fee assessed on the visit stands on its fee record"; the open total would also count the never-assessed charges "for nothing" (only 0.00 open), so a payment now could not settle the trip, household and weekend charges the visit carries ("A collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit ... carries a trip charge"; household and weekend likewise).
- Fall-back answer: 200.00 (computable from the computation documents alone), distinct from 194.45.
